name: Timed Content Locker
author: wpmakedev

sections.description:
Timed Content Locker helps you control when content becomes available to your users. Whether you want to drip content, run timed promotions, or restrict sensitive information temporarily, this plugin is simple and effective.

Key Features:

  • Restrict content by user roles.
  • Set custom countdown timers for content release.
  • Show customizable messages during the restriction period.
  • Lightweight and compatible with most WordPress themes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpmake-time-lock directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Tools -> Timed Content Locker -> Global Settings.
  4. Set appropriate default settings for all contents in the site.
  5. Now go to a page or post and enable Restriction on the page.
  6. You are all set now. Enjoy !!
sections.faq:
Do I need to have coding skills to use the Timed Content Locker Plugin ?

No, you don’t need any coding skills. You are just a click away from setting up a Timed Content Lockerer for your site users.

Does the plugin work with any WordPress themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any themes that have been coded following WordPress guidelines.

Is this plugin fully responsive ?

Yes, the Timed Content Locker Plugin plugin design is fully responsive. So you can use plugin’s Timed Content Lockerer and viewer from any devices of any screensize.

Are all your plugins support translation ready? ?

Yes, Any user facing text may that be title, message or notices, all of them are made translation ready. You will have no problem setting up the translations with with translations plugins like Locotranslate, WPML or PolyLang.
